name: range_entry_jump
description: Box begins beyond the default detector range, enters at 1.4 s, then robot performs an assumed jump cycle.

expected.note: detect.Params.max_forward=3.0 m is measured from the camera, which simcam mounts 0.15 m ahead of the axle (simcam CAMERA_POS, ASSUMED): face distance = 3.5 - 0.15 - 0.25*t reaches 3.0 at t = 1.4. No live 1.3 m range override assumed.
DecisionParams.jump_min_h=.03 <= .08 <= jump_max_h=.12; confirm_n=3; CROUCH starts at jump_at_s = 3 s.

Jump gate spec (#169 table, tools/jump_gate): UNCERTAIN from CROUCH start until SETTLE dwell is met = LAND tick (CROUCH+1.07 s rounded to the 10 Hz tick) + 0.3 s dwell. The scripted SETTLE lasts 0.40 s but the gate may return to STAND earlier by design.
Fresh confirmation after SETTLE; DecisionParams.confirm_n=3 and jump_max_h=.12; geometry remains in default range.
